  • Mr Mohlala, 44, a father of four, uncovered an alleged fraud over forged documents linked to building contracts on £80million stadium

 

  • He exposed the alleged corruption, but then came under pressure to resign as chairman as the controversy threatened to overshadow the World Cup

 

  • In 2009 Mr Mohlala was murdered by two masked gunmen who shot him outside his house - the day before he was due to give evidence in court

I got Cities:Skylines (-33%) from today's sale. Yesterday I got Wolfenstein The New Order (sale still on at 75%).
The Borderlands series is on sale, which will provide 100+ hours gaming.

The Wolf Among Us (75%) is a fresh noir take on classic fairy tales, and is one in a long line of Telltale's amazing story-driven point and click adventure games.

If you're a fan of the genre, the Sherlock Holmes franchise is also mostly 80% off. I've personally only played the two most recent ones, but I found them both very enjoyable.

Prison Architect is 85% off for a pretty fun Early Access prison-building simulator. Having originally bought it a year ago, however, I'm not exactly amazed by the amount of progress since then.

Little Inferno is more of an "interactive toy", but at 75% off, you're definitely getting your money's worth. Basically, you burn things to get money to buy more things to burn to get money. There's even a cute little story to move things along.

Lastly, the only thing more difficult than Gods Will Be Watching (75%) is living with the decisions you've made. It's a point and click thriller set in space, the minimalistic art style belying how easily it will challenge your ideas of good and evil.
